children: GRVT Token has a supply unlock scheduled for 29 Mar 2027. The release covers 66.49 million GRVT, equal to 24.62% of the circulating supply, across airdrop, ecosystem and investor allocations.
Most of the tokens released in the unlock go to airdrop recipients. With that allocation becoming available all at once, the release sharply increases the amount of GRVT that holders can sell.
